source.check: the three divisions and names read from the Frontier Sentinel's 'Newry No. 1 Rural Council' nominations report (29 April 1933, p. 5)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only three candidates were nominated for the fourteen divisions; all the other outgoing members were automatically returned and there were no contests. Those placed by the new council's annual meeting (30 May 1933) are added with their divisions inferred from the 1930 return; Ballycoshone, Clonduff, Crobane and Rathfriland North and South are not yet placed. Returned unopposed.
